claims.value: Boutourlin dates Platov’s recall and replacement by Miloradovich to the night 28–29 August Russian calendar (=9–10 September Gregorian).
claims.rationale: Explicit phase handover explains possible authority scope difference; exact replacement fields still unset. English rendering (ours): "In the night from the twenty-eighth to twenty-ninth Platov was recalled and Miloradovich replaced him in command of the rearguard."
